first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ—the most acute signal. memory_86 showed simplification lifts adoption; memory_31 demonstrated durability of signup-field reduction in SMB. Both are direct precedents for addressing the completion decline. I'm verifying memory_86 (to confirm the magnitude and mechanism of completion lift) and memory_73 (to assess whether promotional pricing should be reserved as a secondary response to competitive pricing pressure, rather than deployed now). A small guarded test of simplified onboarding targets the immediate operational need without committing the full week's capacity, and preserves the option to pivot to promotional pricing if competitive churn accelerates. Activation recovery may follow from faster time-to-value.
